feeds.title: SCVFoodie
feeds.description: The SCVFoodie blog is about food in and around the Santa Clarita Valley, California. It is a blog dedicated to finding gastronomical gems amid the fast-food chains in the area. The blog posts reviews of restaurants, recipes, and food news from the Santa Clarita Valley. It gives you an honest take on the dishes and deals.

feeds.title: Las Delicias Blog
feeds.description: Las Delicias Blog is Mexican food, cuisine, and recipe blog. The blog covers recipes for lunch, dinner, and even breakfast. The recipes are easy, understandable, and easy to make as they are accompanied by a step-by-step guide.

feeds.title: What The Fab Podcast
feeds.description: The What the Fab podcast is a show where empowered women empower women through candid conversations, inspiring stories, and tangible life tips. Focused on amplifying women's voices and helping you be the best version of yourself, host Elise Armitage is a digital creator who left her 9-5 job at Google to chase her dreams of being an entrepreneur. Let's get into some real talk.@wtfab / whatthefab.com

feeds.title: Santa Clarita Valley Economic Development Corp.
feeds.description: The SCVEDC Blog is the official blog of the Santa Clarita Valley Economic Development Corporation. The blog provides updates on economic development, new developments, business attraction, business assistance, workforce development, and other topics related to the Santa Clarita Valley and its surrounding business community.

feeds.title: Jennifer A Douglas Blog
feeds.description: Jennifer A Douglas writes to encourage, enrich, and empower those diagnosed with DCIS, Stage 0 Breast Cancer, during their diagnosis, treatment, and recovery. Areas of focus include treatment decisions, coping with side effects, emotional and mental well-being, and practical tips for seeking and receiving support.

feeds.title: Santa Clarita Valley Therapy Services Blog
feeds.description: Santa Clarita Valley Therapy Services is the official website of Santa Clarita Valley Therapy Services, a physical therapy clinic located in Stevenson Ranch, CA. They offer physical, aquatic, and occupational therapy services to help patients recover from injuries and conditions such as back pain, shoulder pain, sciatica pain, knee pain, balance disorders, sports injuries, foot pain, and more.

feeds.title: Santa Clarita Valley Corvette Club
feeds.description: The Santa Clarita Valley Corvette Club was established in 1978 by a small group of Corvette owners to bring together enthusiasts from all walks of live to share in the adventures experienced in Corvette ownership. Like the Corvette itself, their club continues to evolve, improve, and change.

feeds.title: Southern California Real Estate Management Blog
feeds.description: Southern California Real Estate Management, Inc. was founded in 1987 and has grown to become the largest property management company of individually-owned single-family homes and condominiums in the Santa Clarita Valley. SCREM specializes entirely in residential property management.

feeds.title: JSG Insurance Services Blog
feeds.description: In 2002, the Agency opened as Jon Gardner Insurance and Financial Services, a Farmers Insurance Agency. They were extremely successful and built a profitable business over 11 years. They evaluate, Educate, and Explain to help their clients understand their coverage before they have a loss. Read their blog and undertenant abut them, their services, tier past work, client stories, feature stories and more.

feeds.title: Dentist in Santa Clarita Blog
feeds.description: Follow the Harmony Dental of Santa Clarita blog for updates on dental topics of interest, including dental implants, veneers, tooth bonding, and more. Harmony Dental Care in Santa Clarita, are dedicated to providing their patients with exceptional and comfortable dental care.

feeds.title: Santa Clarita Bail Bonds Blog
feeds.description: The latest news in Santa Clarita! Laws, bail, arrests, Santa Clarita Sheriff station, jail, city updates & more. Follow our blog for the freshest content! Our local agency provides our clients and the community at large no cost, private bail bond consultations and the fastest release available. We are the closest physical agency to the Santa Clarita Sheriff Station Jail and always provide caring, ethical, private, professional bail service 24 hours a day.

feeds.title: Santa Clarita Advanced Dentistry Blog
feeds.description: At Santa Clarita Advanced Dentistry, their main priority is to provide beautiful, healthy smiles to their patients. Secondly, they have worked really hard to build their practice into something they can be proud of. They know they are doing a good job when their patients leave them great reviews. Follow their blog for all kinds of interesting and fun articles relating to dentistry.

feeds.title: Zonta Club of Santa Clarita Valley Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1974, Zonta Club of Santa Clarita Valley is a dynamic organization of professional women working together to advance the status of women and girls in the Santa Clarita Valley and around the world. They are a world in which women's rights are recognized as human rights and every woman is able to achieve her full potential. Read their blog to know more about their organization, their services, their past work and more informative articles.

feeds.title: Aesthetic Dental Blog
feeds.description: Aesthetic Dental & Specialty Center, a dental clinic in Santa Clarita, California. They offer a wide range of dental services, including veneers, dental implants, root canals, and cosmetic dentistry. Their blog feature article on detail health, oral hygiene tips, treatment information, and more.

feeds.title: Follow Your Hart Home
feeds.description: Randy Plaice is a real estate broker and the owner of Randy Plaice and Associates, a real estate team that is part of REAL Broker Technologies. On their site, they feature properties for sale, offer free home value estimates, and provide information about their services. Thier blog shares information about their services, their past clients, past projects, helpful real estate tips, and more.

feeds.title: Snacks and Slow Jams
feeds.description: Snacksandslowjams.com is a food blog run by Kym, a DJ and foodie who combines her two loves: food and music. She creates original audio mixes and shares them on her social media accounts, including Facebook Reels and TikTok. Kym has also visited a candy store to try their freeze-dried candy and shared her experience on Instagram.

feeds.title: Santa Clarita Valley Education Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The SCV Education Foundation works closely with all five school districts within the Santa Clarita Valley. The SCV Education Foundation blog features articles about a variety of education-related topics, including back-to-school tips, funding for public schools, success stories from students and teachers, upcoming events and fundraisers, and the importance of education.

feeds.title: SCV Birth Center Blog
feeds.description: Established in 2010, the SCV Birth Center honors a woman's natural ability to birth her baby while ensuring her safety through extensive evidence-based training and skill. It is the only nationally accredited birth center in the SCV, Antelope Valley, and San Fernando Valley. All of its California Medical Board-licensed midwives provide personalized maternity and well-woman care including natural childbirth, home birth, and water birth options. Do you have questions about pregnancy, nursing, home birth, natural birth, or water birth? Find the answers you're looking for in its blog.

feeds.title: Porsche Santa Clarita Blog
feeds.description: At Porsche Santa Clarita, they take the car shopping experience to the next level. By focusing on each client, they offer a personalized approach to fitting you with a new or previously driven Porsche. From selecting your leather upholstery to matching you with an appropriate financial institution, their attention to detail ensures a memorable purchasing and ownership experience. Explore the blog for news, articles, and an overview of the cars by the brand.

feeds.title: Santa Clarita Hearing Center Blog
feeds.description: At the Santa Clarita Hearing Center, they provide individuals with access to the latest advancements in hearing technology, designed to improve their daily lives. The facility offers a comprehensive array of diagnostic hearing solutions, spanning from thorough hearing assessments and fitting and maintenance of hearing aids to the provision of personalized earplugs, protective devices, and tinnitus management. Read the latest news and insights about Santa Clarita Hearing Center's new hearing aid products, in-depth interviews, and insight into new technology. contentment of its patients.

feeds.title: Santa Clarita Sister Cities
feeds.description: Santa Clarita Sister Cities is a non-profit organization that promotes cultural and educational exchange between Santa Clarita, California, and three sister cities: Sariaya, Philippines; Tena, Ecuador; and Surgut, Russia. The site has a section for news, where you can find information about recent events and activities organized by the organization.

feeds.title: Visit Santa Clarita
feeds.description: The Visit Santa Clarita site is the official tourism website for Santa Clarita, California. It provides information on things to do, places to stay, and events happening in the city. Visitors can also book hotel reservations and sign up for the city's monthly newsletter on the website.

feeds.title: The Neal Weichel Group Blog
feeds.description: The Neal Weichel Group is a real estate brokerage firm in Santa Clarita, California. They have been in business for over 30 years and have helped over 5,000 clients buy and sell homes in the area. G though their The Neal Weichel Group Blog for News, tips and information on buying and selling real estate in Santa Clarita Valley.

feeds.title: Excel Pest Management Blog
feeds.description: Serving Southern California, Excel Pest Management is a value-driven, service-oriented pest control company with over 25 years of combined experience in the pest control industry. They are a small business that can provide you with the care you deserve, while still being big enough to tackle your worst pest problems. The experts at Excel Pest Management offer this blog to provide Santa Clarita property owners with information about their area's toughest pest pressures.

feeds.title: The Rafeh Group Blog
feeds.description: Recently posted or modified blog Brokered by eXp realty. The Rafeh Group represents the region's finest properties with exceptional skill using the most innovative technologies currently available. The Rafeh Group offers ultimate privacy and security, speed, and efficiency. Their years of full-time experience have given them a clear understanding of the mindset of home buyers and sellers and a thorough understanding of the regional marketplace.

feeds.title: Santa Clarita Magazine
feeds.description: Enjoy local content and valley gossip. With easy-to-read, tabbed sections, Santa Clarita Magazine provides Santa Claritans inside information they need to experience the best this town has to offer. From the best places to dine, to medical professionals, business professionals, recreation, fitness, and more, this is the magazine for all things Santa Clarita.

feeds.title: Santa Clarita Real Estate Blog
feeds.description: Visit the Santa Clarita Real Estate Blog for Santa Clarita Housing Market Updates by Robert Mickelson, Realtor. They share Tips and advice for buying or selling a home in Santa Clarita, and the latest housing market updates.

feeds.title: Autism Speaks SCV Blog
feeds.description: The Topping Brothers are a close knit band, literally a 'Band of Brothers' in action working to support Autism Speaks, the leading non-profit advocating for research and treatment for those afflicted with Autism. While supporting Autism Speaks is their main goal at this point, their little band of brothers is not only supporting Autism Speaks, but is planning a foundation with longer-term battle plans such as providing scholarships for families that cannot afford the therapies that are available.
